summary: Created directly in doing. Fabio asked for a playbook to make flow images, naming HyperFrames and Krea2. Measurement first: the slot is ONE field feeding THREE placements, not the two he assumed, and sharp is already a dependency so the compositor needs no HyperFrames scaffold. Art direction is his call and is the only blocker on generating anything.

Playbook written and routed. Also healed 01-descriptor-and-ops.md, which told authors to 'reuse any existing webp' - the instruction that produced all three placeholders. Everything below the art direction is blocked on Fabio's pick.

Scope grew from docs to code on Fabio's direction: the hero is a WIDE 8:5/16:9 autoplaying loop, a second asset, not the 4/5 tile still. Shipped FlowDef.video + the MpiBaseFlow hero renderer (fdaaa164), proven live in an isolated instance on port 55123 - autoplaying, muted, looping, natural aspect at 446px - plus the broken-filename fallback to the still. 630/630. He also named the case the playbook now turns into a rule: Add Foley changes nothing on screen, so a before/after would be two identical panels; animate the added channel instead. Blocked on his per-flow device pick and before/after material.

Two of three flows now carry purpose-built art. Add Foley first (Fabio's pick), then Head Swap from the group A plates he supplied mid-session. ffmpeg alone built both heroes - HyperFrames was not needed and is now scoped in the playbook to type-and-graphics heroes. Extend Video is the last placeholder. Also noted, NOT this card's: shared-dep-uninstall-direction fails on master over LTX tier-family deps, which is MPI-579/580 territory.

Extend Video shipped, so all three flows now carry purpose-built art. Verified the two clips are the same shot BEFORE trusting the device: result trimmed to the source's 56 frames -> PSNR avg 37.3 dB (min 31.0), so the 57.74% marker is truthful. Hero plays the result under a progress rail - source share in --ink-3, an --ink-1 mark where it ended, the rest in --accent-heat; 1280x800, 5.5s, 815 KB, fades black-to-black to loop. Tile is a portrait crop of the walk with the rail complete, 50 KB. Both 200 byte-exact off an isolated instance, hero measured 444 px playing muted/looping. 630/630 (the shared-dep-uninstall test the last handoff flagged now passes). Two findings: --accent-heat is #FF7EB6, NOT the #FF5FA2 the playbook recipe carried and both earlier heroes baked in - playbook healed, those two assets still hold the wrong pink; and a hero probe passes with nothing on screen unless a project is open on the Gallery page, now a playbook trap.

doing -> done. All three shipped flows now carry purpose-built tile + hero, all three approved by Fabio. Extend Video's device was proved before being built on (result trimmed to the source's 56 frames -> PSNR avg 37.3 dB, so the 57.74% marker is real). Assets measured, served 200 byte-exact, hero verified playing at 444 px in an isolated instance. 630/630, release:check passed, claim auditor 7/7 proven. Also fixed --accent-heat (#FF7EB6, not the invented #FF5FA2 in the playbook recipe) and added three playbook traps. Evidence in validation.md.
